DESCRIPTION: Collage on a 32 x 18 grid with up to 16 layered cells in a fixed, user-chosen layout. Editorial presets (poster, spread, index): footage, giant type windows, hairline instruments. Experimental type presets (glyph-flood, slit-scan, echo-stack and their Hangul / paper / calm variants, echo-ripple, type-eq; fonts Monument Extended, Pretendard and MesloLGS NF named from the installed set): the engine text sheet is warped by the shader every frame (slices, stretch, row-delay shear, smear, echo stacks and ripples, band-cut fills, micro-type fields) so letters move on the music while the cells hold their place. The old boxed tile panels (frame tile) and layoutMode reshuffle remain
